title: Mock: 45-minute HLD
summary: Timed 45-minute HLD mocks with the tutor as interviewer: checkpoints at 0:10/0:25/0:40, follow-up probes from a per-case-study bank, one mid-way requirement change, an eight-dimension senior rubric and a log per mock; four mocks at meets on distinct, unseen problems.

units.title: The 45 minutes under a real clock

outcomes.text: Run a 45-minute HLD round against the clock: numbers by 0:10, an end-to-end diagram by 0:25, closing by 0:40, stop at 0:45, and recover out loud when behind.
Answer follow-up probes (scale-up, failure, consistency, cost, security, why not X, how would you know) from your own design in 30-90 seconds: anchor, mechanism, cost, flip.
Absorb a mid-way requirement change (scale, topology, contract, constraint, product) as a delta in at most 3 minutes, naming what doesn't change and what the change costs.
Score your own mock on the eight-dimension rubric with evidence, apply the caps and the overall rule, and land within one level of the tutor on every dimension.
Turn each mock log into one concrete fix and a section to revisit, and track phase slips, probe verdicts and calibration across mocks.
Pass four hld-45 mocks at meets on distinct, unseen problems.
